integrity: The proof is analytic and uses only explicit ball-mass estimates, weighted mean-oscillation bounds, Lebesgue differentiation on compact interior intervals, and a direct power-function obstruction. No numerical experiment or independent audit is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exact phase diagram for the power-weighted interval family, not a classification of arbitrary doubling spaces. It does not identify minimal extra hypotheses that would recover the lower-regularity equivalence after the threshold \(\lambda=p+1\).
title: Power-weighted interval counterexample to the doubling-only Campanato criterion
